feat(json-pointer): resolve RFC 6901 JSON Pointers

Export resolvePointer(document, pointer) from src/index.ts, with the
JsonPointerError it throws and the JsonValue type of the documents it
reads. Parsing lives in parsePointer, module-internal so the features
built on pointers share one definition of a valid pointer.

Follow the RFC 6901 grammar strictly in both directions: accept the
empty pointer, empty member names and a trailing slash; reject a
dangling "~", an array index with a leading zero, and "-", the token
for the position past the last element. Read own properties only, so
"/__proto__" does not reach the prototype chain. Failure is an
exception rather than undefined, because a member may hold null,
false, 0 or "", and codes 'invalid-pointer' and 'unresolved' tell a
malformed pointer apart from a document that does not answer it.

Tests run straight on the sources under Node's type stripping, which
needs ".ts" import specifiers; tsc rewrites them when it emits.

Refs dl-001, dl-002, task-001.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
